issues.title: Copy Orders
issues.body:
A player may wish something to happen daily, for 7 days.

The current model is just to create it for 7 days.  But, that would only generate on route-out and one route-back - whereas there should be multiple instances.

So, players will need to create 7 instances of the orders.   That will be a pain.

A "copy" button would help.

Here is how "copy" would be implemented:
- select single orders document
- "copy" button appears in planning orders toolbar
- when clicked, a duplicate of the plan will be created, but with reference and id stripped out.
- this will be pushed to the "new orders" panel, for the player to complete.  This is similar to the processing we do for "create orders"
